name: Trinity P.
bio: Trinity has worked for several years at large boarding/daycare facilities and has also cared for police/service dogs. She is currently completing a Bachelor’s degree in Education and has successfully finished courses in dog first aid, behaviour, social cues and administering canine medication. She has two dogs named Harley and Josie and enjoys camping with them. Some of her hobbies include playing baseball and teaching her dogs new tricks.
